metadata.name: e21-preferences-changed-only-readback
metadata.description: Change one disposable owner's notification category, preserve its sibling, and confirm persisted preference after reload.
Update one test-owner preference category without altering a sibling category; verify UI and API readback after reload.

metadata.label: Open the owner settings page with the leased two-category preference fixture
Wait for the disposable owner preference catalog

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const card=document.querySelector('[data-testid="notification-source-e43-fixture-source"]');const d=card?.querySelector('input[aria-label="Enable Delivery updates"]');const c=card?.querySelector('input[aria-label="Enable Critical notices"]');const ds=card?.querySelector('select[aria-label="Delivery updates · Minimum urgency"]');const cs=card?.querySelector('select[aria-label="Critical notices · Minimum urgency"]');if(!d?.checked||!c?.checked||ds?.value!=="normal"||cs?.value!=="critical")throw new Error(`unexpected preference baseline ${JSON.stringify({delivery:d?.checked,critical:c?.checked,urgencies:[ds?.value,cs?.value]})}`);return {source:"e43-fixture-source",categories:["delivery","critical"],enabled:[true,true],minimumUrgencies:{delivery:"normal",critical:"critical"}}})()

metadata.label: Verify both disposable categories start from their declared defaults
Change only the Delivery updates preference
Wait for the changed category to return from owner-scoped catalog readback
Reload the same leased owner preference view
Wait for persisted preference values after reload

evaluate.expression: async()=>{const card=document.querySelector('[data-testid="notification-source-e43-fixture-source"]');const d=card?.querySelector('input[aria-label="Enable Delivery updates"]');const c=card?.querySelector('input[aria-label="Enable Critical notices"]');const ds=card?.querySelector('select[aria-label="Delivery updates · Minimum urgency"]');const cs=card?.querySelector('select[aria-label="Critical notices · Minimum urgency"]');const response=await fetch('/api/v1/notifications/catalog',{headers:{'X-Vrooli-Browser-Session':'1'},credentials:'same-origin',cache:'no-store'});if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`owner catalog readback failed ${response.status}`);const catalog=await response.json();const saved=catalog.preferences.filter(x=>x.source_scenario==='e43-fixture-source');if(d?.checked||!c?.checked||ds?.value!=='normal'||cs?.value!=='critical'||saved.length!==1||saved[0].category!=='delivery'||saved[0].enabled!==false)throw new Error(`changed-only preference mismatch ${JSON.stringify({enabled:{delivery:d?.checked,critical:c?.checked},urgencies:{delivery:ds?.value,critical:cs?.value},saved})}`);return {changedCategory:'delivery',enabled:false,siblingCriticalEnabled:c.checked,siblingMinimumUrgency:cs.value,storedPreferenceRows:saved.length,persistedAfterReload:true}}
